scope: Default-off device-local overlay lock command in the existing shared shortcut registry, recorder, conflict checking and persistence. Explicit enabling or recording opts in; reset returns to inactive. Windows globalShortcut registration uses bounded code/modifier projection, not additional raw uIOhook event collection.

Only the trusted main-window frame can configure the native binding. Modifier-only, unsupported keys and unmodified overlay chords are rejected. Registration failures are shown; recording, command disable, overlay master disable, unmount, main navigation/crash and quit release the owned reservation. PTT/global mute physical-key conflicts suspend overlay registration.

The chord unlocks an already-visible authorized voice widget for mouse dragging without activating/focusing its BrowserWindow. Lock restores whole-window click-through. Hiding clears interactive state. Main-process will-move clamps game-mode dragging to the authorized game bounds; changed bounds relock/reposition the widget. Manual position lasts only for the visible session and is not yet persisted.

Registered Games exposes a real issue-report action through the existing FeedbackCreateForm and API. It submits user-authored text and optional explicit attachments, never automatically collecting process paths, screenshots, duration or process data.
